name: GET /api/leadflow/contacts - the faceted list
description:
The contacts worklist, read from the LOCAL lead projection rather than from sdk-search. A search index that has not caught up would drop a lead somebody created two minutes ago, and on a worklist that reads as the lead being lost.

EVERY FACET GOES TO THE SERVER so the counts always describe the window the rows came from, and a filtered list is shareable by URL.

WHAT THE LIST DOES NOT KNOW IS STATED, not blanked. trust_state and channel_state come back null with a field_gaps entry explaining where they live — a blank trust column reads as "no trust concerns", and an eligibility verdict cached onto a list row would outlive the consent that produced it. QA: measured live returning 1327 contacts over the web_form facet with 4 declared gaps.

testCases.name: The list returns rows, totals, facets and its declared gaps
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
